ideas.name: Gold Delivery Month Return Premium
ideas.claim: COMEX gold futures had a higher mean monthly log return in their final month before expiry than in their preceding month; the paper attributes the difference to delivery risk.
ideas.quote: Whereas the term structure was almost flat for oil, gold clearly shows a higher mean return for the last month.
ideas.mechanism: Delivery-period overlap and associated position flows
ideas.claimed_result: Mean monthly log return was 0.33% for one-month contracts versus -0.03% for two-month contracts; gold data span 1979-01-22 to 2019-02-28.
required_data: Individual COMEX gold futures contract prices
Contract expiry and first notice dates
